This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Food Technology specification.

Food Preparation and Cooking Techniques appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Food Preparation and Cooking Techniques in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Preparation and Cooking Techniques.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
